title: libds error model
preamble:
# libds error model

Error conventions, status-code taxonomy and
detail-string lifetime rules for libds. Takes the
`ds_result_t` commitment from
[IARC.1.12] and
the struct shape from
[IDAT.2] as fixed.

## What this is not

- Not a rationale for the `ds_result_t` shape — that
  lives in [IARC] and [IDAT].
- Not a wire-error spec. libds has no wire format
  ([IARC.2.3]); error codes are C-level only. If an
  integrator bridges errors across processes, they
  pick the encoding.
- Not a log-format spec. Integrators log whatever
  they want; libds only surfaces structured errors.
